advisor.reasoning: Run max 80.6F at 14:40Z with current temp 27C (80.6F) — flat for 30+ min. South wind 11-15kt sustained = onshore advection cap mechanism active. Upstream KNYG/KRMN max 79.9F, advection ceiling ~81F. Guidance 85.6-88F but tape shows pace deficit ~7-8F vs needed target with no acceleration. Ladder market: B85.5 YES at 53c implies median near 86F, B87.5 YES at 38c — market sees meaningful probability of 87-88F but the live temp plateau at ~81F with moist southerly flow (dew 18-19C) argues the airmass ceiling is binding. Wet-bulb suppression + onshore advection = classic DC south-wind cap. Clearing 84F requires +3.4F from current stall. Not confident enough to CONCUR.
advisor.watch: Temperature breaks above 28C (82.4F) on next obs with wind dropping below 9kt — that would signal cap eroding and support CONCUR

advisor.reasoning: Current temp locked at 17°C (62.6°F) with OVC BKN1400-1800ft marine overcast — cloud bases LOWERING print-to-print (1800→1400ft), a hard lid mechanism. S/SSW onshore flow 11-15 m/s with marine deck intact: sea-breeze analogue suppressing heating. Max upstream 66.2°F; airmass T850=60.9°F. Need +11.4°F rise to clear 74°F ceiling. Guidance (78°F) is wishful; the tape shows zero warming slope across 10 consecutive obs at 17°C. 15°F pace deficit flagged. Market B75.5 at 48/52 correctly prices near-coin-flip for 75-76°F — far above current. Deck fate is capping, not dissolving. This day stays cool; NO position loses.
